summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancements to the integration with Spark, including async reader improvements and support for variant types. Additionally, proposals for better REST specifications and access control mechanisms are being actively explored.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal for generic CatalogObjectIdentifier in REST spec
Discussion on adding Basic Authentication to OpenAPI for REST Catalog
Enhancements to OAuth2 experience in Iceberg REST clients
